The drug recognized as the breakthrough of the year in science in 2024 is **Lenacapavir**, which was named the *2024 Breakthrough of the Year* by *Science* magazine (https://www.news.uct.ac.za/article/-2024-12-13-lenacapavir-named-2024-breakthrough-of-the-year-a-new-era-in-hiv-prevention).

The company associated with the drug is **Gilead Sciences**, and its Chairman & CEO is **Daniel O'Day** (https://www.gilead.com/stories/an-open-letter-from-daniel-oday-chairman-and-ceo).

However, the specific location where Daniel O'Day completed his undergraduate studies could not be found using the available search results.
